10.2.4.title: Improved Folder view
10.2.4.description: Folder view gets updated with new header and better laid-out menu options.

10.2.3.title: Song ratings
10.2.3.description: You can now Like/Dislike any song. This uses Apple Music API so the ratings will be visible in the AM app and will be used for Smart Playlists.

10.2.2.title: Play favourites
10.2.2.description: While on Album/Artist/Playlist you can now choose to play only songs that are added to Favourites. Tap Play icon in header to display this option

10.2.1.title: Modernized look
10.2.1.description: Plum now supports Liquid Glass across most of its UI.

10.2.title: Refreshed visuals
10.2.description: Album, Artist and Playlist screens get a visual refresh. Featuring first touch of Liquid Glass in the app (which I'm slowly growing fond of)

10.2.title: Playlist Folders
10.2.description: Apple Music Playlist Folders are now displayed in Folders tab

10.2.title: Search
10.2.description: Replaced built-in MusicKit's search solution with a much faster, fully custom one (Apple Music variant)
